chapter: The state of jazz, future plans and close
title: Thanks and sign-off
summary: Brown thanks Barron on behalf of the Smithsonian and NEA.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: If I did anything right, I can always credit Kenny Barron, because I got schooled right. I want to just say on behalf of the Smithsonian Institution and the National Endowment for the Arts, Kenny Barron, thank you so much for taking this time to be able to share your thoughts.

And letting folks know that this music is important and you’ve dedicated your life to it. That tells me – inspired me to be able to follow in your footsteps and also embrace this music and make sure that it stays something that is rooted in the humanity of the people who created it.
All right, Kenny. Thank you so much.
